meta.name: edit-article
meta.description: Edit and improve articles by restructuring sections, improving clarity, and tightening prose. Use when user wants to edit, revise, or improve an article draft.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 润色文章结构、清晰度和措辞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有文章草稿需要提升质量
copy.tagline_en: Polish article structure, clarity, and prose
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an article draft to improve

howto.what: Claude 会先根据标题将文章分成若干部分，并检查各部分之间的逻辑依赖关系，然后与用户确认分段方案。之后逐段重写，每段不超过240字符，以提升清晰度、连贯性和流畅度。
howto.when: 当用户要求编辑、修改或改进一篇草稿文章时触发。

say.text: 帮我编辑这篇文章，让它更清晰流畅。
say.note: Claude 会先分段并确认，然后逐段重写。

say.text: 请改进这篇稿子的结构和表达。
say.note: Claude 会分析逻辑依赖并优化段落顺序。

howto.what_en: Claude will first divide the article into sections based on headings, check logical dependencies between sections, and confirm the plan with the user. Then it rewrites each section (max 240 characters per paragraph) to improve clarity, coherence, and flow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to edit, revise, or improve an article draft.

say_en.text: Edit this article to make it clearer and more fluent.
say_en.note: Claude will first segment and confirm, then rewrite each section.

say_en.text: Improve the structure and expression of this draft.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze dependencies and optimize section order.
